about_the_game:
LUGH WORLD – A Massive Online Monster-Taming Adventure

Lugh World is a massive online adventure where every step unlocks new possibilities. Discover the City of Miranda, capture and evolve Lughs — one-of-a-kind, charismatic creatures — and uncover secrets scattered across a living, ever-changing world.

It’s not just about battles — it’s about friendships, rivalries, and the freedom to forge your own journey. In Lugh World, you connect with players from all over the world, share stories, and build memories in a universe that’s constantly evolving.

Add Lugh World to your wishlist — be among the first pioneers of a new age of adventure!

Step into Lugh World — a universe filled with unique regions, diverse cultures, and secrets hidden in every corner. From floating islands to frozen canyons, each biome delivers fresh discoveries and bold challenges.

At the heart of this world lies Miranda — the great city that pulses as the meeting point for players — a hub of trading, socializing, and epic battles.

And of course — the true stars: the Lughs. Fascinating creatures, rich in personality, elements, and signature abilities — turning every encounter into a new story.

Lughs are unique beings of mystical nature, born from the Light of Creation. Because of this special origin, they possess incredible powers and special abilities.

As you explore the world alongside your Lughs, gain experience and grow stronger together. Lughs can take on new, more powerful forms as they gain experience.

Some Lughs evolve in a linear progression:

While others branch into a non-linear evolution path:

In addition, you can use rare items to help your Lugh evolve and unleash its full potential!

A single Lugh can manifest multiple forms. Discover every variation — not only in appearance, but also in skills and attributes. Your collection has real strategic value here!

Final-form Lughs can even become your mounts! Not just traveling by land — your Lughs can run, fly, or swim to take you to new, unexplored areas once unreachable.

Wield different types of crystals to catch new Lughs and expand your squad. Chase ultra-rare Lughs and become a world-renowned collector.

Face the living world of Lugh World alongside your friends. Wild creatures, colossal bosses, and ancient mysteries await those who venture into the unknown lands. Every battle is a chance to gather loot, earn experience, and unlock new challenges.

Choose your fight style: command in third-person via your Lugher — or take direct control for razor-sharp tactics.

Nothing matches the thrill of competition! Challenge players worldwide in electrifying duels. In the arenas, skill and strategy collide — and only the best become legends.

Manage your Lughs, gear, and resources through a clean, intuitive interface. Organize your collection, equip your partners, and prepare for any challenge.

Every encounter in Lugh World can turn into a new opportunity. Trade rare Lughs and valuable items in real time with other players, expanding your collection and creating new strategic possibilities.

Trading goes beyond simple exchange — it’s a social and economic bond within the world, bringing trainers closer together and strengthening the community. Every trade tells a story — and might change the course of your journey.

Dive into a true online MMORPG where everything happens in real time. Here, battles, encounters, and events unfold alongside thousands of players from around the world.

Form alliances, explore cities and regions with friends and rivals, join dynamic events, and dive into thriving marketplaces that reflect the strength of the community. No two sessions are the same — the world of Lugh World never stops evolving.

A persistent, vibrant, social universe — shaped not only by its developers, but by every adventurer who enters it.

Discover Lugh World’s saga through in-game quests. Explore the City of Miranda and its surroundings while helping the Lugh Research Center understand the world. Form alliances with city guilds, travel to new regions, and delve deep into Lugh World’s mysteries! But beware — many trials await, and not everything is as it seems.

You’ll be able to customize your character to reflect your unique style. But individuality isn’t limited to your avatar — customize your Lughs, home, and gear. Your personal style is your mark on the world!

The Lughpad is a technological tablet-like device — logs every Lugh that Lughers encounter along their journey. This tool provides valuable information both for the player and the Lugh Research Center.

Record general data about Lughs, catalog variants, and expand your knowledge about these incredible creatures.

Whenever you register a new Lugh in your Lughpad, you earn a Caught Card! Collect cards to unlock extra lore and insights about the Lughs. Capture Cards can contain curiosities, variant details, rarity data, and much more!

Experience the freedom of gliding through the skies with your paraglider! Explore new areas and soar across the heavens in thrilling aerial adventures!

Join seasonal events, crush challenges, and unlock exclusive skins, titles, and cosmetic items with the Lugh World Battle Pass.

Complete themed missions, unlock legendary skins, and earn exclusive rewards every season. The Battle Pass encourages constant participation and rewards dedication with rare items, titles, and unique customizations.

Some mysteries can only be solved when every piece falls into place. Be prepared to face several puzzle-style challenges! And remember: the greatest mysteries can only be unraveled by a wise team of explorers.

There are truly menacing challenges—enraged gigantic Lughs so powerful that only a large, coordinated team of skilled Lughers can defeat them. These are the boss raids — co-op experiences that bring towering difficulty and unique rewards!

Join forces with other players, challenge colossal Lughs, and leave your mark on the game’s history!

Lugh World is a fantastical realm where humans live in harmony with nature and share existence with amazing beings called Lughs.

Humans respected — some even revered — the Lughs, and the world knew peace for a time. But peace was not eternal. One day, a girl named Manu was found unconscious on a beach. She could understand the Lughs — and they seemed to understand her. Manu began a journey across the world, searching for a way to reunite with her father.

Years later, in the City of Miranda, one of the city’s ancient portals roared back to life — and many strangers emerged. They claimed to come from a place called “Earth” — searching for a girl named Manu. These newcomers founded the Lugh Research Center in Miranda to study this new world, its unique creatures (the Lughs), and to find Manu.

Apparently, only youths from Earth can communicate properly with Lughs, making cooperation possible.

Today, Manu protects ordinary folk from enraged Lughs that appear from time to time.

And you, young explorer — became a powerful ally of the Lugh Research Center in the search for Manu—and in uncovering the mysteries of Lugh World!

Lugh World consists of continents and islands with varied biomes and terrain. Each region of the world has a central city — a hub of social and economic connection.

Every region presents its own socio-cultural dynamics and unique history. The past seems eager to reveal itself, as mysterious structures, ruins, statues, and monuments can be found throughout the world — creations that seem built by no one.

Every corner holds part of Lugh World’s secrets.

Within Lugh World, there are forces, powers, and organizations seeking to control the Lughs and their great power to fulfill their own ambitions.

The three main known threats are:

  • The Blight: Its origin is as ancient as the mystery of the Light of Creation itself. When a Lugh—or any creature—is consumed by the Shadow of Ruin, it becomes tainted by the Blight. In extreme cases, those infected transform into monstrous, violent versions of themselves.

  • The Heralds of Ruin: Considered a cult-like group seeking to channel the Shadow of Ruin to destroy the world. Rumors suggest that elite members of the Heralds can control Blighted Lughs just as Lughers control normal Lughs.

  • The Masked Wanderer: Many tales tell of a man wearing a white mask and black cloak. He appears near ruins or areas where unstable crystals erupt with raw energy. He avoids direct contact, observing from afar, but leaves enigmatic marks—symbols carved in stone, runes that seem to contain fragments of Earth’s writing.

Note: this text is under active localization — report issues so we can perfect it.

short_description: Lugh World is an action monster-taming MMORPG set in a living, ever-evolving open world. Capture and evolve unique beings called Lughs, explore a vast world, and face epic challenges in real-time battles. Uncover secrets, forge your own path, and live the game you’ve always dreamed of!
